=== 72x24 ===
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                      │
│  moomux commands                                                     │
│                                                                      │
│  Sessions                         Navigation                         │
│    n          new session           ↑ / k              move up       │
│    f          find session (all     ↓ / j              move down     │
│               projects)             shift+↑↓ / KJ      reorder       │
│    enter / o  open (attach tmux)                       session       │
│    x          park (kill tmux)      tab / ] / →        next project  │
│    d          delete (or all        shift+tab / [ / ←  prev project  │
│               marked)               } / {              ...incl.      │
│    space      mark to delete                           empty ones    │
│    M          mark merged/closed    shift+←→ / HL      reorder       │
│               PRs                                      project       │
│    esc        clear marks           R                  force-copy    │
│    a          archive session                          ticket/PR     │
│    A          show archived                            links: off    │
│    p          pin to top / unpin                                     │
│    t          tag ticket / PR                                        │
│                                                                      │
│  ↑↓/jk/pg scroll  ?/esc close                                        │
│                                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
